description: Relay one authorized browser action into the user's already-authenticated browser. Actions: navigate, inspect, click, input, select, read, wait. Password/hidden fields and off-allowlist navigation are denied. API and bridge documentation: https://ghostkey-mcp.onrender.com/session-bridge/README.txt.

action.description: The browser action to relay: navigate, inspect, click, input, select, read, or wait. Password and hidden fields and off-allowlist navigation are denied.

agent_token.description: Agent token issued with the session at creation; authorizes actions inside this session only.

attribute.description: Attribute name to read for an inspect/read action (up to 100 characters), e.g. href or value.

selector.description: CSS selector (1-500 characters) identifying the element for click, input, select, inspect, or read actions.

text.description: Text to type for an input action, or the option value/label for a select action (up to 4000 characters); never used for password or hidden fields.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the action to complete (1000-30000).

url.description: Target URL for navigate/read actions; must be on one of the session's allowed origins.

name: ghostkey_session_action
title: GhostKey Session Action
